Proof in the paper: High-resolution TEM image of an individual NW displayed two sets of lattice fringes with the d-spacings of 2.31 and 2.01 Å, respectively, which were ascribed to (111) and (200) planes of face-centered cubic (fcc) PdAg alloys (Fig. 1d). The corresponded Fourier transform (FT) pattern further confirmed the [110] crystalline observation direction along the NW.
